filing_fee_notes: Online filing is 150; paper filing is 165. Online annual reports are 55; paper reports are 70.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain a qualifying individual or business agent with physical and mailing addresses in South Dakota.
standard_processing_time: Online filings are processed immediately; paper filings generally take 1–3 business days.
annual_report_due: First day of the formation anniversary month, beginning in the following year.
unemployment_insurance_agency: South Dakota Department of Labor and Regulation, Reemployment Assistance Division
plain_english_summary: Online formation costs 150 and the online annual report costs 55. The report is due at the start of the anniversary month.
common_mistake: Waiting until the end of the anniversary month misses the report deadline.
notes: Ordinary domestic LLC; series LLC fees differ. Filing URLs are official gateways with online filing links. Tax registration URL covers sales and use tax. Name-search URL, expedited service, franchise or privilege tax, publication requirement and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
